evidence.section: SOK to Splunk Enterprise version compatibility; Upgrade path guidance
evidence.statement: The 3.2 Help matrix lists SOK 3.2.0, Kubernetes 1.32–1.37 and Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0. The September 8 changelog lists Kubernetes 1.32–1.36 and Enterprise 10.6.0. The Help upgrade guidance puts SOK first. Both scope the Queue secret change to Index and Ingestion Separation. The ranges and dates remain in conflict. Confirm the exact version combination before operational use.
